headline: Broader verification- and edge-path test coverage for the SAML SP and the database primitives
summary: Adversarial and edge branches of b.auth.saml and b.db are now under explicit test. No behaviour changes: every path — including the SAML signature-verification and audience/condition refusals, and the database encrypted-boot fallbacks — was confirmed to behave per its documented contract.

items.title: Verification- and edge-path tests for the SAML SP and database primitives
items.body: b.auth.saml (the XML-signature Reference handling with no URI or no Transforms, a foreign-namespace Conditions element failing closed to no-audience-restriction, RSA-OAEP SHA-384/SHA-512 key transport with AES-128-GCM assertion decryption, ed25519 sign/verify dispatch, and the single-logout build/parse paths) and b.db (encrypted-boot key and envelope fallbacks, flush-to-disk after close, the audit-chain rollback check against a non-empty log, and the boot-time NTP check thresholds) now have explicit tests for their boundary branches. Behaviour is unchanged.
